ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels vs 25% low-intensity (black/dark) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Low-intensity (black) pigmentation forms a continuous band along the entire trailing edge. A significant irregular dark region is centered at the base of the fluke near the median notch. Numerous small (1-5 pixel) dark focal spots are scattered across the high-intensity medial surfaces of both lobes. A prominent, larger circular dark spot is localized on the mid-section of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: The central depression forms a sharp V-shape with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 45 degrees and a bounding-box depth of approximately 15% of the total vertical fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel amplitudes ranging from 2 to 10 pixels are extracted along the entire trailing edge boundary. Serration density and amplitude are highest at the distal tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edges of both lobes follow a generally convex curve from the median notch to the distal tips, punctuated by micro-scale serrations.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast dark pixels are visible at the distal tips of both lobes. A single, distinct, roughly circular low-intensity pixel cluster is located on the medial-right fluke surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple unaligned linear pixel disruptions are visible. The left lobe exhibits near-vertical parallel dark lines near the upper edge. The right lobe exhibits at least three distinct diagonal dark lines extending from the trailing edge toward the center.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent linear rake marks (scars) are visible across both lobes. Deep, irregular serrations and notches at the distal tips indicate historical tissue loss or trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: A highly unique, isolated, high-contrast dark circular spot is located in the center of the right lobe, serving as a primary distinguishing mark.
